inspection_outcome: Six established findings: two Major defects in the field-family and finite-spanning constructions, and four Minor corrections.
summary: The missing regularized base family contradicts nested spanning. Independently, single original-flow pullbacks fail in the core spanning-to-spray construction. Iterated enlargement supplies a bounded repair without lowering this core defect to Minor. Four further local corrections remain Minor; the final factorization theorem is not disproved.

problems.title: Missing regularized base fields make the stated nested spanning family impossible
problems.source_location: Definition3.19 p20; V2/Definition3.35 p30; Theorem3.36 p31; Lemmas3.39–3.42 pp32–34; vanishing formulas pp18–20
problems.claim: A2 subset A3 subset Gamma(V3), where V3 contains only L=3 principal fields; V2 unregularized chart pushforwards are global complete fields.
problems.assumptions: n2, Z1=diag(0,1), Z2=diag(0,-1), Z3=0, section3 transposed convention.
problems.check_method: Exact root matrix recursion, vanishing and pullback argument, direct coordinate derivation of poles; helpers independently supplied a conjugate n2 example.
problems.decisive_evidence: Phi2=Phi3=(e2,0). All V3 fields vanish since Ptilde2=0, so every Q3 field vanishes. The generic Phi2 fiber has dimension2 and A2 contains (P1_2)^2 d/dz1,11=d/dz1,11 here. Inclusion is impossible. Raw V2 contains d/dz2,22-(a2/a1)d/dz2,12+(a2/a1)^2 d/dz2,11 with genuine poles.
problems.result: Printed field definitions contradict nested spanning conclusion and cannot directly support the non-generic base spray.
problems.counterevidence: Multiplication by a1² yields a complete polynomial translation field. Regularized finite base fields span every generic two-factor fiber. No non-factorizable null-homotopic holomorphic map found.
problems.impact: Substantive compatibility repair required in core stratified-ellipticity proof; main final theorem not refuted.

correction.statement: Define regularized global base family, include its lifts in every VK, and recheck generated-field restrictions and nested/non-generic interfaces.
correction.verification: Regularization, completeness and base spanning checked; complete revised induction not certified.

independent_acceptance_check.decisive_evidence: Phi2=Phi3=(e2,0). Printed V3 starts atL3; its coefficients vanish at Ptilde2=0. All generated flows fix this point, so every Gamma(V3) field vanishes there. Generic two-factor fiber has a nonzero dz1,11 tangent direction that A2 must span; claimed A2?A3?Gamma(V3) is impossible.

problems.title: Single-flow pullbacks do not produce the asserted finite spanning family
problems.source_location: Lemma3.30 pp28–29; Lemma3.31 and Corollary3.32 p29; generic spray after Theorem3.36 p31; Lemma3.39 p32; Remark3.43 p34; Theorems3.3/2.10 and Corollary2.11/Theorem2.12.
problems.claim: The finite union of single original-flow pullbacks of original A spans the saturation.
problems.assumptions: M=C3,A={d/dx,x d/dy,y d/dz},U={xy!=0}; all fields complete.
problems.check_method: All nine single-pullback types at origin, exact flows, and reconstruction of a finite iterative rank-locus repair.
problems.decisive_evidence: CA(U)=C3, but every (alpha_t^V)^*W, V,W in A, has zero z-component at origin for all t. A two-flow composition has pullback(y+x+1)d/dz, nonzero there.
problems.result: Printed construction fails, though the lemma's existence conclusion can be repaired.
problems.counterevidence: Iteratively pull back current Br, not just original A. On saturation, each irreducible rank-defect component admits an original-flow escape; common times by countable-component Baire argument remove every component generically. Dimension drops to empty in finite rounds.
problems.impact: False printed finite-spanning construction lies in the core stratified-ellipticity and Oka-lifting proof. Its iterated repair does not remove the Major classification. No counterexample to the finite-extension existence statement or final factorization theorem.

correction.statement: Use Br+1=Br union {(alpha_t(r,V)^V)^*W:V in A,W in Br}; use irreducible components.
correction.verification: Root independently reconstructed the counterexample and finite dimension-drop proof.
correction.status: explicit iterated repair supplied; core-proof defect remains Major

problems.severity_basis: Demonstrated core dependency, not ease or length of repair.

independent_acceptance_check.source_location: Lemma3.30 PDF28?29; Lemma3.31/Cor3.32 p29; generic spray p31; Lemma3.39 p32; Remark3.43 p34
independent_acceptance_check.assumptions_checked: Stein M=C3; complete X=?x,Y=x?y,Z=y?z; open connected U={xy!=0}; saturation is allC3 by first translating x and then y.
independent_acceptance_check.decisive_evidence: All nine single original-flow pullbacks have zero z-component at the origin for every time. The printed finite union cannot span there. The composition pullback of Z is (x+y+1)?z and supplies the missing direction. Actual native SymPy calculation PID76220 exit0 corroborates all nine exact formulas; full command/stdin/stdout retained.
independent_acceptance_check.repair_checked: Use current B_r in each pullback, and irreducible analytic rank-defect components. A component invariant under all original flows cannot reachU; otherwise a chosen point has discrete bad times. Common times avoid the countable union, remove a point from every component, and lower dimension each round. Finite dimension yields finite enlargement. This supports the existence conclusion, not the printed construction.
independent_acceptance_check.core_dependency: Lemma3.31 imports the construction; p31 and Lemma3.39 use it for generic/non-generic sprays; Cor3.32 and Remark3.43 feed stratified ellipticity and Theorems3.3/2.10,Cor2.11,Theorem2.12.
independent_acceptance_check.severity_basis: Demonstrated failure in a core proof construction warrants Major. Availability of the iterated repair is not a reason to lower severity. Neither finite-extension existence nor final factorization is disproved.
